public_sources.bound_semantics: Luby, Sinclair and Zuckerman define a universal restart strategy with run lengths 1,1,2,1,1,2,4,1,1,2,1,1,2,4,8,... for unknown runtime distributions and prove an O(l log l)-type bound relative to the best known-distribution strategy for Las Vegas algorithms.

chat_native_reduction.mapping: Use the universal power-of-two sequence only as a durable logical retry-budget schedule when the appropriate recovery cutoff is unknown. A cutoff resets ephemeral attempt state, not immutable role evidence/checkpoints.
chat_native_reduction.durability_rule: Persist schedule index and attempt generation. Controller restart resumes the next precommitted budget instead of replaying the prefix.
chat_native_reduction.fence_rule: Late completion from a cut-off attempt generation is stale and cannot affect current assignment or credit.
chat_native_reduction.theorem_scope: The Luby theorem assumes independent randomized Las Vegas runs. This Chat reduction does not claim that theorem or expected-runtime optimality because recurring Chat attempts need not satisfy those assumptions.

environment_results.details: Universal budgets1,1 cut off noncompleting attempt1 after1 transition and let attempt2 succeed at its first transition, total2. Fixed1 also totals2; fixed4 waits4 on attempt1 then succeeds at1 on attempt2, total5.

When success requires a budget of at least4, fixed1 has no success in first10 attempts; fixed4 succeeds in4 total transitions; universal first reaches budget4 on attempt7 after total budget1+1+2+1+1+2+4=12. Universal is not best on this environment but eventually supplies the needed longer cutoff without preselecting4.
Attempt1 completion arriving after its cutoff while attempt2 is current fails exact attempt_generation and has zero effect/credit.

After consuming budgets [1,1,2,1], durable index=4 reconstructs the next budget1. Resetting the schedule prefix on every controller restart is rejected because repeated restarts at that point could prevent ever reaching budget4.

credit_rule: At most one role-local credit after exact terminal readback; creation alone earns zero credit.
scope_limit: Fixed logical retry traces only. No claim that Luby scheduling is optimal for deterministic or dependent Chat attempts, no claim of wall-clock guarantees, and no use of external compute.
